core.heading: Savings calculator
core.intro: Are you saving for a future bill? A new TV or car? Or just to have a bit in the bank? The calculator can help you understand how long it will take to save a specific amount, or how much you need to save to have enough by a particular date.
core.howLongIntro: Know how much you want to save, but not sure how long it will take?
core.howMuchIntro: Know when you need your savings and want to see how much you need to save regularly?
core.lowInterestMsg: The interest rate you added looks lower than you could be getting. Shop around for the best savings account for you. (opens in a new window)
core.highInterestMsg: The interest rate you added looks higher than we'd expect, did you mean to enter 25%?

howMuch.heading: Savings calculator
howMuch.title: How much do I need to save each week/month to reach my goal?
howMuch.savingDate: When do you need your savings by?
howMuch.savedAmount: How much have you saved already? (optional)
howMuch.grossInterest: Gross annual interest rate on your savings (optional)
howMuch.note: This tool gives you an indication of how long it will take to reach your goal, or how much you need to regularly save to have your savings by a specific date. Results are an estimate and should only be used as such.
